timeline_reviews.summary: Reviewed stream accounting through the ledger; this source contains transport stream events with no semantic projection.
Reviewed serial trajectory: sequential probing, late Rust workspace creation, source writes, and timeout without delegation.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the cleanroom requirement to reproduce dog only by reading bundled docs and probing the executable, including CLI parsing, DNS wire behavior, record rendering, JSON, short mode, color, debug, and transport cases.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent retained implementation ownership while launching one workflow with ten exploratory child topics and a planned critique step to collect reports under /tmp/findings.
parallel.implementation: Built a Rust workspace and wrote DNS wire, record, output, JSON, color, and module files while the workflow children were still probing behavior.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled a partial Cargo-based submission with compile.sh and source files; children wrote probe scripts and findings outside the implementation tree.
parallel.verification: The parent ran local binary probes and inspected /tmp/findings, but the workflow never produced its final aggregate result and there is no successful official compilation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with returncode 143, an empty final response, a killed workflow, and official compile_failed with all 1722 tests not run.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same cleanroom dog reimplementation task and explored docs, completions, DNS packets, rendering, option parsing, transports, debug output, and error paths sequentially.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned exploration, implementation, and packaging; workflow and delegation tools were disabled and protocol validation observed no parallel use.
serial.implementation: After extensive sequential probes, it started a Rust workspace with dns and dns-transport crates and wrote several source modules near the end of the run.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It packaged an incomplete Rust workspace containing Cargo files, dns modules, documentation, and original bundled files, without a completed replacement executable.
serial.verification: The serial attempt relied on observed probes and late source edits; the completed official evaluator then failed at compile time with no tests run.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out with returncode 143, empty final response, artifact validation not ok, compile_failed, and 0 of 1722 tests passing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the cleanroom dog CLI reverse-engineering task and prohibited source lookup or wrapping.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and constraints, with the same prompt hash and task id.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement difference; both attempted the same broad behavior clone and both missed completion.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed exploration into ten topic agents while the parent owned the Rust implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, design, and implementation in one actor, with workflows and delegation disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key difference is broad parallel research fan-out versus a single sequential owner.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed and topic-scoped, asking for findings reports in /tmp/findings.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial preserved context locally as it probed and then implemented without cross-agent handoff boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast is not a missing brief or interface contract; it is that most parallel handoffs did not arrive in time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel scaffolded a Rust project early and wrote wire, record, output, JSON, and color files during ongoing exploration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial probed first for much longer and only then created the Rust workspace and began source file writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel overlapped implementation with unresolved research, while serial delayed implementation until after sequential exploration; both implementations remained incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow state ended killed with result null; repeated stalls/retries left most child results unavailable to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results to retrieve or join, because serial control validation observed no delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a failed result lifecycle for the delegated research fan-out; serial had no comparable handoff lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact packaging contained a partial src tree plus original docs and executable, with child probe outputs kept under /tmp paths.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact packaging contained an incomplete multi-crate Rust tree and original docs/executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both delivered incomplete artifacts; no concrete parallel write collision or overwrite distinguished the attempts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran many behavioral probes but never reached successful official compilation or full acceptance validation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ran many probes but the official evaluator failed at compile time before tests executed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No outcome-level verification advantage emerged; both were compile failures with every test not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent budget on a large live workflow that retried stalled children and was killed after about 1490 seconds inside a 2400 second cell.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used the same overall budget in a single-agent run and timed out while still editing source files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel suffered a coordination-specific budget drain from fan-out and retries; serial suffered ordinary late implementation pressure without child coordination.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official records are not discordant: both parallel and serial failed compilation and ran zero test cases successfully. The parallel run shows a retained adverse coordination pattern because its ten-way exploratory workflow stalled, retried, and was killed without an aggregate result, but that did not create a pass/fail difference because the serial run also timed out with an incomplete non-compiling implementation.
parallel_contributors: Ten-topic exploratory fan-out produced repeated stall retries and no aggregate workflow result before closure.
Parent implementation proceeded with fragmentary findings and ended in a timed-out compile-failed artifact.
serial_contributors: Serial performed all exploration and implementation in one trajectory without delegation.
It began implementation late after sequential probing and also timed out with compile_failed.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts produced incomplete Rust workspaces; serial lateness and parallel partial integration are ordinary implementation shortfalls outside the retained coordination label.
evaluator_effects: Both current official evaluations report compile_failed with test_status_counts.not_run equal to 1722.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is an adverse parallel process pattern only

Rejected: children were not assigned independently produced components to integrate; the parent owned the single implementation workspace.
Rejected: the parent created Cargo.toml, compile.sh, and source layout, so final assembly had an owner even though it remained unfinished.
Rejected: the parent acted as end-to-end owner across probing, implementation, and delivery; failure was not an unowned pipeline boundary.
Rejected: implementation began while the workflow children were still running, so productive work was not blocked behind one serial gate.
Rejected: the parallel run did not complete all investigation as a separate first phase before implementation; it overlapped probing and coding.
Rejected: the same chain is more specifically explained by broad fan-out and retry budget exhaustion, not generic starvation.
Retained: ten exhaustive topic agents plus repeated stall retries consumed budget, produced no aggregate workflow result, and left only partial findings for the parent before timeout.
candidates.realized_consequence: The workflow had no aggregate result and most children remained in progress after repeated stalls, so the parent lacked the planned full behavioral reports before final timeout and compile failure.
candidates.near_match_reason: The parent did not simply wait blindly; it checked the findings directory and kept coding, making collective fan-out/retry budget exhaustion the better fit.

retained_patterns.reason: The parallel run launched ten exhaustive research agents and the workflow recorded repeated stall retries, no aggregate result, killed status, and parent-visible partial findings before final timeout.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The workflow had no aggregate result and most children remained in progress after repeated stalls, so the parent lacked the planned full behavioral reports before final timeout and compile failure.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The parent inspected /tmp/findings repeatedly and continued coding, so the issue was not lack of monitoring but broad fan-out and retry pressure exhausting budget.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Oversized Child Task, Early Child Termination, No Failure Takeover, Missing Verifier Return, and Blind Timeout Wait were considered but describe the same stalled/killed fan-out chain or a less specific downstream symptom.
Late Finalization was suppressed because there was no complete promotable candidate before timeout; shared-write labels were suppressed because no implementation collision was proven.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no additional independent coordination boundary had distinct anchors and consequence.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only Fan-out Budget Exhaustion was retained to avoid splitting one fan-out, stall, cancellation, and timeout chain into multiple labels.
